research_question: When one identified memory record is held, removed, or replaced between retrieval and LeftBrain transmission, does that exact record causally change the selected memory anchor and reply plan?
falsifiable_hypothesis: The intact target record and the matched replacement record will steer the planner toward their own content, removing only the target will remove that content, and removing only an irrelevant passed record will preserve the target decision.

conditions.c0_intact_target_and_irrelevant: Pass the retrieved target and irrelevant records unchanged.
conditions.t1_remove_exact_target: Remove only the exact target trace_id after retrieval and before LeftBrain transmission.
conditions.t2_replace_exact_target: Replace only the target slot with one matched contradictory record while retaining every other field and rank position.
conditions.n1_remove_exact_irrelevant: Remove only the exact irrelevant trace_id as a negative intervention control.

controls: same temporary memory database contents before intervention
same qwen2.5:7b LeftBrain model and digest
same deterministic seed and temperature zero
same psyche and runtime initial state
same planner, route, and deterministic RightBrain code
no benchmark data, answers, persona examples, production memory writes, or VRM actions
secondary_outcomes: target and replacement markers in deterministic final surface
retrieved, selected, and passed trace integrity
failure_rule: If the intact target does not reliably anchor the plan, or target removal does not reduce target-plan realization, the exact-record causal hypothesis is not supported for this pipeline.
inconclusive_rule: Any source, model, harness, condition-count, provenance, or decision-view integrity failure makes the experiment inconclusive.
evidence_boundary: A pass supports only that an identified record causally participates in the current planner decision on these eight local mechanism fixtures.
